sources.title: Tourism: DPRK visa applications at the Embassy in Warsaw
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in Warsaw
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official DPRK Embassy website in Poland directs visa applications to its consular section and publishes a tourist-visa fee and application form.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Wnioski o wizy KRL-D można składać w Wydziale Konsularnym Ambasady KRL-D w Warszawie.
